_description: Complete recipe for electricity/lightning effects. Covers arc lightning, chain lightning, static discharge, and Tesla coil variants.

base_architecture.design_philosophy: Electricity is FAST, IRREGULAR, and BRIGHT. Key traits: random branching, rapid flicker (on/off), white-blue color core, thin sharp lines.

emitter_layers.name: Lightning_Bolt
emitter_layers.purpose: Main lightning arc between two points
emitter_layers.renderer: beam (Spawn Beam module) or ribbon with jagged path

approach_options.beam_module: Use Spawn Beam or Update Beam between start/end points. Add noise to control points for jagged appearance.
approach_options.ribbon_particles: Spawn particles along path with random perpendicular offsets, connect with ribbon renderer. More control but more setup.
approach_options.mesh_spline: Pre-made lightning mesh spawned between points. Fastest but least flexible.

emitter_layers.flicker: Random on/off at 15-30 Hz. Lightning should NOT be continuously visible.

emitter_layers.name: Branches
emitter_layers.purpose: Smaller branching lightning from main bolt
emitter_layers.color: slightly more blue than core, emissive 10-30
emitter_layers.notes: Branch from random points along main bolt. Shorter and thinner than main.

emitter_layers.name: Glow
emitter_layers.purpose: Soft ambient glow around bolt path
emitter_layers.renderer: sprite (along bolt path) or ribbon (wide, low opacity)
emitter_layers.notes: Creates the atmospheric glow. Fades slower than bolt itself.

emitter_layers.name: Sparks
emitter_layers.purpose: Small bright particles at endpoints and along bolt
emitter_layers.spawn: burst: 5-15 at start/end points, 2-5 along bolt
emitter_layers.notes: Spawn on each bolt strike. Rapid burst, fast death.

emitter_layers.name: Impact_Flash
emitter_layers.purpose: Bright flash where bolt hits surface/target

arc_lightning.description: Single bolt between two points (power lines, Tesla coil)

modifications.duration: continuous as long as system active

modifications.multi_target: Bolt jumps: point A → B → C → D

static_discharge.description: Small surface sparks (damaged electronics, charged object)

modifications.flicker_rate: irregular, 1-5 strikes per second with random gaps

lightning_strike.description: Large atmospheric lightning bolt (sky to ground)

modifications.ground_impact: large spark burst + ground scorch + radial shockwave
modifications.thunder_delay: visual first, sound delayed by distance

electrified_character.description: Character being electrocuted / charged with electricity

modifications.spawn_on_mesh: Skeletal Mesh Location on character bones/surface
modifications.bolt_paths: short arcs between nearby body parts (hand→elbow, shoulder→hip)
modifications.surface_sparks: small sparks emitting from character surface
modifications.body_glow: fresnel material overlay, blue, flickering intensity

method_1_beam_module.description: Use Spawn Beam / Update Beam with noise on control points
method_1_beam_module.setup: Spawn Beam between two points, add noise to BezierControlPoints, respawn frequently

method_2_segmented_ribbon.description: Spawn N particles along line, offset perpendicular randomly, connect with ribbon
method_2_segmented_ribbon.pros: Full control over shape, can animate per-segment
method_2_segmented_ribbon.setup: Grid Location along line, Jitter Position perpendicular, Ribbon Renderer, short lifetime for re-randomization

method_3_material_based.description: UV-scrolling lightning texture on ribbon or plane
method_3_material_based.pros: Cheapest, works well for distant/background lightning
method_3_material_based.setup: Single ribbon, material with lightning texture panning along U, noise distortion on V

flicker_implementation.approach_1: Randomize emitter spawn with Spawn Burst + random delay between bursts
flicker_implementation.approach_2: Use visibility parameter driven by random noise threshold (noise > 0.7 = visible)
flicker_implementation.approach_3: Very short particle lifetime (0.02-0.05s) + rapid re-spawn = natural flicker

key_principles.irregularity: Lightning MUST be irregular. Regular patterns look fake. Randomize timing, position, intensity.
key_principles.fast_and_brief: Individual strikes are 1-3 frames. If lightning stays on too long it looks like a glowing rope, not electricity.
key_principles.brightness_contrast: Lightning needs VERY high emissive (20-100+) to look energetic. The brightness contrast with surroundings sells it.
key_principles.afterimage_glow: Bolt disappears fast but the glow lingers 0.1-0.3s. This creates the afterimage effect.
key_principles.branching_from_main: Branches always originate FROM the main bolt and are thinner/shorter. Never thicker than main.
key_principles.sound_is_half_the_effect: Electricity without crackling sound feels incomplete. VFX timing should match audio pops.

niagara_modules_needed: Spawn Beam / Update Beam (for beam approach)
Spawn Burst Instantaneous (repeated at random intervals)
Jitter Position (perpendicular offset for jagged look)
Curl Noise Force (slight, for organic movement on bolts)
